key_findings: Source grounding with inline citations demonstrated as product feature (src-001 Gemini Notebook)
RCT evidence: LearnLM moved from 50th to 64th percentile (14 percentile rank difference), math, 8 weeks, 1,763 students in Sierra Leone (src-003)
RCT evidence: Tutor CoPilot +4 to +9 percentage points on topic mastery; 700+ tutors, 1,000+ students from underserved communities (src-004)
ChatGPT Study Mode documents user-requested teaching styles; design inference: whether explicit instruction is technically required vs. available option not directly stated (src-002)
Knowledge Space Theory enables learner modeling at scale: ~350 concepts → millions of states; 25-30 questions via Markovian procedures (src-005 ALEKS)

Knowledge Tracing survey: side information (response time, hints, attempts) provides richer signals than correctness alone for structured exercise interactions; exercise-level features (difficulty, discrimination) enable task-specific modeling (src-006)

OLM meta-synthesis: four OLM categories (inspectable, negotiable, editable, adaptive) form learner agency continuum; 26 studies demonstrate consistent gains in engagement, persistence, outcomes for inspectable OLMs; adaptive OLMs integrate learner model transparency with personalized feedback (src-007)

LMS digital logs review: 82 predictive models from 39 papers, average 0.72 accuracy after 5.85 weeks; behavioral trace data (views, downloads, submissions, forum contributions) orthogonal to summative performance; metadata-enriched feature engineering transforms raw interactions into outcome prediction measures (src-008)
unresolved_issues: Layer 1: Preventing model knowledge leakage when sources incomplete; handling ambiguous or conflicting source content
Layer 2: Vocabulary and notation constraint enforcement mechanisms; assessment criteria alignment; academic integrity preservation beyond external policy
Layer 3: Automatic obstacle-type detection (terminology gaps, prerequisite deficits, language barriers, procedural vs. conceptual confusion); lost context recovery strategies

Layer 4: Operational definitions for 'understood example' vs. 'can solve independently'; single-instance success vs. consistent performance criteria; intervention effectiveness (whether acting on predictions improves outcomes)

Layer 5: Unified learner model across reading, debugging, and structured exercises; transfer assumptions across task types; skill decomposition granularity for unstructured tasks; cross-domain knowledge state transfer
